description_en: Modifies the settings of a configuration group, such as scheduled task configurations
description_zh: 修改配置组的具体设置，例如定时任务的配置
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-timer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --group-id cg-i1ruuudp92qpj0000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTimerGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. This feature is not region-specific. Set this parameter to `cn-shanghai`
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。该功能无地域属性，该字段固定填写`cn-shanghai`
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow end users to configure scheduled tasks
fields.help_zh: 是否允许终端用户自行配置定时任务
fields.name: allow_client_setting

fields.help_en:
The cron expression for the scheduled task.

Specify the time in UTC. For example, to schedule a task at 00:00 (UTC+8) every day, set this parameter to 0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
fields.help_zh:
定时任务Cron表达式。

需要传入UTC标准时间，即北京时间每天0点应该传入0 0 16 ? * 1,2,3,4,5,6,7
fields.name: cron_expression

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly execute the task. If set to true, the scheduled task is forcibly executed regardless of the desktop and connection status
fields.help_zh: 是否强制执行。为true表示忽略桌面及连接状态检测，强制执行定时任务
fields.name: enforce

fields.help_en: The time interval. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 时间间隔，单位为分钟
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The advance notification time before the scheduled task is executed. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 定时任务执行前的通知提前时间。单位：秒
fields.name: notification_time

fields.help_en: The operation type of the scheduled task. Currently, only disconnect scheduled tasks support this parameter
fields.help_zh: 定时任务操作类型，目前仅断连定时任务支持
fields.name: operation_type

fields.help_en: The process whitelist for intelligent detection of no-operation scheduled tasks. If a specified process is running, the no-operation scheduled task is not triggered
fields.help_zh: 无操作定时任务智能判断的进程白名单，如果指定的进程正在运行则不支持无操作定时任务
fields.name: process_whitelist

fields.help_en: The reset type, which determines whether to reset and the scope of cloud disks to reset
fields.help_zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围
fields.name: reset_type

fields.help_en: The appointment timer that executes scheduled tasks at specified time points
fields.help_zh: 定点执行定时任务使用，指定后可以按照指定时间点执行定时任务
fields.name: appointment_timer

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to create a snapshot
fields.help_zh: 是否创建快照
fields.name: create_snapshot

fields.help_en: The cron expression for the end time of the scheduled task
fields.help_zh: 定时任务结束执行的 Cron 表达式
fields.name: end_cron_expression

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly execute the task. If set to true, the scheduled task is forcibly executed regardless of the desktop and connection status
fields.help_zh: 是否强制执行。为true表示忽略桌面及连接状态检测，强制执行定时任务
fields.name: enforce

fields.help_en: The image ID
fields.help_zh: 镜像ID
fields.name: image_id

fields.help_en: The time interval. Unit: minutes
fields.help_zh: 时间间隔，单位为分钟
fields.name: interval

fields.help_en: The list of IP CIDR blocks for which the task takes effect
fields.help_zh: 生效的 IP 网段列表
fields.name: ip_segments

fields.help_en: The duration of inactivity before the screen is locked for the no-operation lock screen feature. Unit: minutes. Only AD-joined cloud desktops are supported
fields.help_zh: 无操作锁屏功能使用，指定无操作后触发锁屏的时长。单位：分钟。仅 AD 云电脑支持
fields.name: lock_screen_time

fields.help_en: The advance notification time before the scheduled task is executed. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 定时任务执行前的通知提前时间。单位：秒
fields.name: notification_time

fields.help_en: The operation type of the scheduled task. Currently, only disconnect scheduled tasks support this parameter
fields.help_zh: 定时任务操作类型，目前仅断连定时任务支持
fields.name: operation_type

fields.help_en: The process whitelist for intelligent detection of no-operation scheduled tasks. If a specified process is running, the no-operation scheduled task is not triggered
fields.help_zh: 无操作定时任务智能判断的进程白名单，如果指定的进程正在运行则不支持无操作定时任务
fields.name: process_whitelist

fields.help_en: The reset type, which determines whether to reset and the scope of cloud disks to reset
fields.help_zh: 重置类型，决定是否重置，以及要重置的磁盘范围
fields.name: reset_type

fields.help_en: The cron expression for the start time of the scheduled task
fields.help_zh: 定时任务开始执行的 Cron 表达式
fields.name: start_cron_expression

fields.help_en: The execution order number of the timer
fields.help_zh: 定时器的执行顺序号
fields.name: timer_order

fields.help_en: The time zone used by the scheduled task
fields.help_zh: 定时任务使用的时区
fields.name: timezone

fields.help_en: The trigger configuration type for no-operation scheduled tasks
fields.help_zh: 无操作定时任务触发配置类型
fields.name: trigger_type

fields.help_en: The advance notification time before verification is executed. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 执行校验前的通知提前时间。单位：秒

fields.help_en: The verification wait duration. Unit: seconds
fields.help_zh: 校验等待时长。单位：秒
fields.name: verification_time

fields.help_en: The list of segment timer configurations
fields.help_zh: 分段定时器配置列表
fields.name: segment_timers

fields.help_zh: 定时任务类型
fields.name: timer_type
